description:
Inside Your Brain at 2 AM: Why We Dream — At 2 AM while your eyes stay shut, why does a movie theater switch ON inside your brain?
Kids science answer for "why do we dream for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

During REM sleep, your brainstem pauses body muscles while visual and emotion centers replay memories like a creative night movie, and fluid washes away daytime brain clutter.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
